name: Solar Energy LLC
old_description: I have had my solar panels that got from Solar Energy LLC since 2012. I have had not one bit of a problem with them, I could not be any more satisfied with the performance that I have got out of them. I would highly recommend Solar Energy LLC to purchase and install from,
about:
Solar Energy LLC operates from St. Joseph, Missouri, serving property owners across the northwest corner of the state. The company does not disclose a founding year, though a customer testimonial dates back to 2012. Ownership details are not public; a testimonial references "Jeff and his team," suggesting Jeff may be the founder or principal.

The firm installs solar photovoltaic systems for residential and commercial clients. Its installers work with products sourced from established manufacturers and suppliers rather than producing panels themselves. Services include free on-site estimates and a referral program that pays $500 for each referred purchase. No facility size, headcount, or annual installation volume is published.

Customers include homeowners and businesses throughout Northwest Missouri. Testimonials cite installations on a private residence, an office building, and a commercial facility where the crew assisted with site preparation beyond the original scope.

Solar Energy LLC emphasizes the quality of the equipment it procures and the training of its installation crews. It positions itself on the strength of its supplier relationships and customer service rather than on a stated founding mission.
built_on: Free on-site estimates for residential and commercial projects
Referral program paying $500 per referred system purchase
Installers trained to work with top-tier manufacturer products
Customer service highlighted in long-term client testimonials
type_evidence: Our team of highly-trained installers work only with the industry's best manufacturers and suppliers
